1. After the Second World War the United States of America advocated for decolonization.
The United States of America wanted the colonizing powers to give independence to their colonies.

She wanted to have a freer hand in the exploitation of the ex-colonies. This was known as the Open Door Policy. This was known as the Veto Policy. This was known as the Indirect rule policy. This was known as the Assimilation Policy. This was known as the Direct rule Policy.

__________________________________________. The language that evolved among them was Khoikhoi. Their language was known as Xhosa. They used to speak Spanish and Portuguese languages. They adopted different Bantu languages. The language that evolved among them was Afrikaans.
